user.title: What kind of heating do you have?
user.description: This decides which steps follow and how costs are calculated. You can change it later in the options.

prices.title: Prices
prices.description: All values can be changed later in the options. Efficiency refers to the gross calorific value (Hs), because gas is billed per kWh Hs. For district heating the allocation key matters: only the consumption share is saved when you heat less – the floor-area share is billed regardless. The heat pump therefore has to reach a higher COP to pay off.

reset_learning.title: Reset learning
reset_learning.description: After a change to the installation, learned values no longer fit – for example after hydraulic balancing, new radiators, fitted ducts or a new thermostat. Only the chosen areas are cleared; settings, schedules and modes stay. When the heating curve, duct factor, installation room, served rooms or a room's sensor change, Thriftherm forgets the affected area on its own.

scope.description: boiler, heat_pump and/or rooms. All when omitted.

rooms.description: Room keys; narrows the rooms area. All rooms when omitted.

boost.name: Quick heat-up
boost.description: Heat a room to its comfort temperature as fast as possible (heat pump at full power).

no_schedule.title: {room}: no heating window configured
no_schedule.description: {room} has neither a schedule helper nor a time range. The room stays at its setback temperature for good and is never pre-heated. Create a schedule under Settings → Devices & services → Helpers and select it for the room in the options.

airflow_not_calibrated.title: Heat pump airflow not calibrated
airflow_not_calibrated.description: Without the rpm → m³/h curve there is no thermal power and therefore no COP. The cost comparison falls back to the data sheet until then. The curve lives in the heat pump options.

boiler_data_unavailable.title: No data from the boiler
boiler_data_unavailable.description: ebusd is not delivering usable values right now. Nothing is sent to the boiler; it keeps running on its own front knob. Check the ebusd app and the eBUS adapter.

schedule_missing.title: {room}: schedule helper missing
schedule_missing.description: {room} refers to the schedule {entity_id}, which no longer exists in Home Assistant. The room has no warm periods left and stays at its setback temperature. Recreate the helper or pick another one in the options.

heat_stays_in_the_room.title: Heat pump assigned to rooms it cannot reach
heat_stays_in_the_room.description: The heat pump is set to serve {rooms}, but no duct factor is configured (1.0 means no ducts fitted), so the warm air stays in the room the unit stands in. Until that changes, a run for those rooms heats the wrong one. Either fit the ducts and set the factor in the options, or clear the tick for those rooms.

not_loaded.message: Thriftherm is not set up or not loaded.

return_time_in_past.message: The return time must be in the future.

setback_above_comfort.message: {room}: the setback temperature must not be above the comfort temperature.
